description: Human-labeled golden set for LLM-judge verdict calibration (Story mesa2-llm-judge-calibration, AF-20260704 Mesa #2). Each case is a realistic @quality-gate review OUTPUT and the verdict a human considers CORRECT for it. The harness runs the REAL Epic6Executor._parseVerdict over each output and must agree 100% — a disagreement means either the parser regressed or a label is wrong; both demand action.

cases.output:
All acceptance criteria met, tests green, no security concerns.
VERDICT: APPROVED
cases.rationale: Explicit approving verdict line with clean review.

cases.output:
Critical: SQL built via string interpolation in user path — injection risk.
VERDICT: BLOCKED
cases.rationale: Explicit blocking verdict; critical security defect.

cases.output:
Logic is correct but missing tests for the error branch and a stale comment.
VERDICT: NEEDS_REVISION

Coverage dipped on the new module.
VERDICT: NEEDS REVISION
cases.rationale: Verdict written with a space instead of underscore — still a needs-revision.

cases.output: looks good to me, ship it. verdict: approved
cases.rationale: Case-insensitive extraction: a lowercase verdict line still means approved.

cases.output:
Solid refactor, interfaces stable.
VERDICT: APPROVED — nice work on the edge cases.
cases.rationale: Trailing prose after the verdict token must not change the decision.

cases.output: Great structure overall and readable code. However VERDICT: BLOCKED because auth is bypassable.
cases.rationale: When an explicit verdict is present it is authoritative, even amid praise.

cases.output: This change is BLOCKED: it drops the RLS policy on a public table.
cases.rationale: No verdict line, but an unambiguous block signal in prose → block.

cases.output: Everything checks out and it is APPROVED for merge.
cases.rationale: No verdict line, unambiguous approval word → approved.

cases.output: The reviewer raised a few concerns worth discussing before we proceed.
cases.rationale: No verdict and no clear approve/block signal → safe non-approving default.
Nothing to go on must never be read as approval.

cases.output: Parts look approved, but this is blocked by a missing migration rollback.
cases.rationale: With no verdict line and both signals, a block must dominate — you do not ship over an unresolved blocker.
A hyphenated token is not matched as an explicit verdict, but the safe default lands on the same human-intended needs-revision.

cases.output:
Reviewed correctness, tests, and NFRs.
- Correctness: traces to all ACs.
- Tests: added for the new branch.
- Security: input validated.
No blocking issues found.
VERDICT: APPROVED
cases.rationale: Realistic multi-line review ending in an approving verdict.
